title: A Yearbook for the Prom
author: Silas Fairweather
blurb: August Sandoval, a coder whose anonymous account knows too much, has spent three years being so careful it hurts. But when grandma's recipe box contains directions that aren't for food, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must tell the truth even if it costs the friendship before graduation.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
